meta.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
meta.privacy.description: Privacy policy for Casa Rural Valle de Arbas: what data we process, why, and how to exercise your rights.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Casa Rural Valle de Arbas we respect your privacy. Here we explain what personal data we process when you visit this website or contact us, for what purpose, and what rights you have.
privacy.section.1.title: 1. Data controller
privacy.section.1.body: The data controller is the owner indicated in the Legal Notice, with the following contact details:
privacy.section.2.title: 2. What data we process and why
privacy.section.2.body:
This website has no forms and does not collect personal data automatically. The only personal data we process is what you voluntarily provide when contacting us by email, phone or WhatsApp (name, email, phone number and details of your stay), for the sole purpose of answering your query and managing your booking.

The website stores your preferred language in your browser's local storage (localStorage) to remember it on your next visit; this data never leaves your device, is not a cookie, and does not identify any person.
privacy.section.3.title: 3. Legal basis
privacy.section.3.body: The legal basis for processing your contact data is your own consent when writing to us, and the performance of pre-contractual or contractual measures necessary to manage your booking (articles 6.1.a and 6.1.b GDPR).
privacy.section.4.title: 4. Data retention
privacy.section.4.body: We keep your data for as long as needed to handle your query or booking, and afterwards for the legally required periods (for example, tax obligations), after which it is deleted or anonymised.
privacy.section.5.title: 5. Recipients and processors
privacy.section.5.body:
We do not share your data with third parties unless legally required to. This website checks the house's availability through the public Google Calendar API, which is only used to read an availability calendar; no personal data of yours is sent to Google while browsing the website.

The site is hosted on GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc.), which acts as a data processor solely to serve the website's static files.
privacy.section.6.title: 6. Your rights
privacy.section.6.body: You can exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and portability by writing to the contact email listed in section 1. You also have the right to file a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (aepd.es) if you believe your data is not being processed correctly.
privacy.section.7.title: 7. Security measures
privacy.section.7.body: We apply reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your data against unauthorised access, loss or alteration, appropriate to a website of this kind.

bookingTerms.title: Booking and cancellation terms
bookingTerms.intro: A clear summary of how a booking works at Casa Rural Valle de Arbas, from start to finish. If anything is unclear, contact us before confirming.
bookingTerms.section.1.title: 1. How to book
bookingTerms.section.1.body: The house is rented as a whole, with a two-night minimum. We don't work with intermediaries: simulate your dates on the availability calendar, then message or call us (WhatsApp works too) to confirm the booking directly with us.
bookingTerms.section.2.title: 2. Check-in and check-out
bookingTerms.section.2.body: Check-in is from 5pm and check-out before noon. We'll meet you at the door with the keys.
bookingTerms.section.3.title: 3. Occupancy
bookingTerms.section.3.body: The whole house sleeps up to 10 guests.
bookingTerms.section.4.title: 4. Price and what's included
bookingTerms.section.4.body: The price includes the whole house and final cleaning. Firewood for the fireplace is an optional extra charged separately, which you can add when simulating your stay.

bookingTerms.section.6.title: 6. Cancellation policy
bookingTerms.section.6.body: Full refund if cancelled up to 15 days before the arrival date. After that, half of the amount is refunded.

meta.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
meta.faq.description: Answers to the most common questions about the rural house in Valle de Arbas: schedules, pets, cancellations and more.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Here are answers to the most common questions before booking. If you have any other question, write to us and we'll be happy to help.
faq.q1.question: What are the check-in and check-out times?
faq.q1.answer: Check-in is from 5pm and check-out before noon. We'll meet you at the door with the keys.
faq.q2.question: What's the minimum number of nights?
faq.q2.answer: The house is rented as a whole, with a two-night minimum.
faq.q3.question: How many people can stay in the house?
faq.q3.answer: The whole house sleeps up to 10 guests.
faq.q4.question: Are pets allowed?
faq.q5.question: Is there wifi and heating?
faq.q5.answer: Yes: fibre wifi throughout the house, underfloor heating, and a wood-burning fireplace lit from October and kept burning until May.
faq.q6.question: Is there parking nearby?
faq.q6.answer: Yes, the house has private parking.
faq.q7.question: Is firewood for the fireplace included?
faq.q7.answer: Firewood is an optional extra you can add when simulating your stay; it's charged separately from the house and final cleaning.
faq.q8.question: How do I book, and what's the cancellation policy?
faq.q8.answer: We book directly, with no middlemen: simulate your dates on the calendar, then message or call us (WhatsApp works too) to confirm. Full refund up to 15 days before arrival; after that, half.
